name: CKEditor5 horizontal line
description: Adds a horizontal-line (horizontal rule / <hr>) button to the CKEditor 5 toolbar.
project_description: This module adds the Horizontal Line feature to CKEditor 5. It wraps the official upstream @ckeditor/ckeditor5-horizontal-line npm plugin (HorizontalLine) and exposes it to Drupal's text-format toolbar via a CKEditor 5 plugin definition. The feature lets editors visually divide content into sections by inserting horizontal lines (horizontal rules, <hr>), an easy way to organize content or indicate a change of topic. There is no PHP logic, no configuration form, no routes, and no permissions; enabling the module simply makes a draggable Horizontal Line toolbar button available in the CKEditor 5 toolbar configuration for each text format.
